🔄 Opposites Around Us! 🌈

Big or small? Up or down? Fast or slow? 🤔✨

Our little learners had fun discovering the world of opposites through simple, playful interactions. 

Learning concepts becomes more meaningful when children can see, experience, and express them in their own way. 💛

Through activities like these, children build vocabulary, observation skills, and a better understanding of the world around them—all while having fun! 🌱

Learning through play, one concept at a time. 🥰

🐘🌺 Ganesh Chaturthi Celebrations at Paper Bird Shishukul

Ganpati Bappa Morya! 🙏❤️

Our little learners celebrated Ganesh Chaturthi with joy, devotion, and beautiful festive moments. 🌸✨

Through the celebration, children experienced the beauty of our traditions and learned about Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles and the symbol of wisdom and new beginnings. 🪷🐘

A day filled with smiles, togetherness, and memories that make learning truly meaningful. 💛

Wishing everyone a blessed and joyful Ganesh Chaturthi! 🙏✨

🦚💙 Krishna Janmashtami Celebration at Paper Bird Shishukul
